description: This Java source file defines an Android activity for configuring a digital watch face on a wearable device. It includes UI components for selecting background colors, manages Google API client connections, and handles user interactions to update watch face settings.

classes.name: DigitalWatchFaceWearableConfigActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for configuring the digital watch face, including color selection and Google API client management.

classes.name: ColorListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying color options in the wearable list view.

classes.name: ColorItem
classes.description: Custom view representing a color option with animated expand/shrink effects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and configures GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient when activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the GoogleApiClient when activity stops.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on color items to update the watch face configuration.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: Empty implementation for click on empty list region.

methods.name: onAbsoluteScrollChange
methods.description: Adjusts header translation based on scroll position.

methods.name: onCentralPositionChanged
methods.description: Handles change in central item position (empty implementation).

methods.name: updateConfigDataItem
methods.description: Updates the watch face configuration with the selected background color.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder for color items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds color data to view holder.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color and label for a color item.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the default circle color of the color item.
